purpose: Teach: その道/エゴ/やう/正午/未明/ナンセンス/アンタ/初歩

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんはその道の専門家でいらっしゃるのよ
lines.en: Sho, your father is an expert in his field, you know.
lines.style: Gentle observation, speaking as much to herself as to him. Warm regard. A slight pause before 'you know' — not lecturing, just noticing aloud.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんがエゴを抑えてご家族を優先される姿が尊敬だよ
lines.en: Mom, I really respect how Dad puts his ego aside for the family.
lines.style: Sincere and thoughtful, slightly formal in his phrasing. Speaks clearly, without rushing. The careful precision of a child who's been listening closely to how adults talk.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「やう」って古風な表現を使われたわ
lines.en: Sho, your father used such an old-fashioned expression just now — 'yau.'
lines.style: Gently amused, almost to herself. Noticing the small quirks of someone she knows well. Warm undertone of affection for his particular way of speaking.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、正午にお父さんが帰宅されるそうよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad said he's coming home at noon.
lines.style: Bright, anticipatory tone. Sits forward slightly. Not loud, but the energy of good news — the kind of thing he wants to share right away.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、未明に雷が鳴ってお父さんが起きてらしたわ
lines.en: Sho, there was thunder before dawn and your father got up.
lines.style: Calm observation, the way she might notice something about his routine. No alarm — just noticing. Quiet certainty in her voice.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんに無理難題を言うのはナンセンスだよ
lines.en: Mom, I don't think it makes sense to ask Dad for something unreasonable.
lines.style: Earnest and direct. Speaking from something he's thought about. Not defensive — just clear. The cadence of a child learning to reason things through.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、「アンタ」って呼ぶのは下品よ
lines.en: Sho, calling someone 'anta' is rude and crude.
lines.style: Firm but not sharp. The corrective tone of a mother who's clear about boundaries. Matters-of-fact, the way you'd explain a household rule.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんに料理の初歩を習ったよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad taught me the basics of cooking.
lines.style: Warm and pleased, the happiness of a small memory just resurfacing. Direct eye contact level. A quiet smile underneath the words.
